mapper.insert: insert into conversations(type, name, owner_id) values (#{type}, #{name}, #{ownerId})
mapper.select: select cm1.conversation_id from conversation_members cm1 join conversation_members cm2 on cm2.conversation_id = cm1.conversation_id join conversations c on c.id = cm1.conversation_id and c.type = 1 where cm1.user_id = #{uidA} and cm2.user_id = #{uidB} order by cm1.conversation_id limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into conversation_members(conversation_id, user_id, last_read_msg_id, join_time) values (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, 0, NOW()) on duplicate key update conversation_id = conversation_id
mapper.select: select count(*) from conversation_members where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and user_id = #{userId}

select c.id as conversation_id, c.type as type, c.name as name, c.owner_id as owner_id, c.avatar as avatar, c.notice as notice, c.create_time as create_time, (select count(*) from conversation_members cm2 where cm2.conversation_id = c.id) as member_count, peer.peer_id as peer_id, peer.peer_nickname as peer_nickname, peer.peer_avatar as peer_avatar, peer.peer_status as peer_status, lm.id as last_message_id, lm.content as last_content, lm.message_type as last_message_type, lm.file_name as last_file_name, lm.send_time as last_send_time, lu.nickname as last_sender_nickname, (select count(*) from chat_messages m3 where m3.conversation_id = c.id and m3.id > me.last_read_msg_id and m3.sender_id <> #{userId}) as unread_count from conversation_members me join conversations c on c.id = me.conversation_id left join ( select cm.conversation_id, u.id as peer_id, u.nickname as peer_nickname, u.avatar as peer_avatar, u.status as peer_status from conversation_members cm join users u on u.id = cm.user_id join conversations cc on cc.id = cm.conversation_id and cc.type = 1 where cm.user_id <> #{userId} ) peer on peer.conversation_id = c.id left join ( select m.conversation_id, max(m.id) as max_id from chat_messages m group by m.conversation_id ) lastid on lastid.conversation_id = c.id left join chat_messages lm on lm.id = lastid.max_id left join users lu on lu.id = lm.sender_id where me.user_id = #{userId} order by coalesce(lm.send_time, c.create_time) desc, c.id desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from conversation_members cm where cm.user_id = #{userId}
select u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.status from conversation_members cm join users u on u.id = cm.user_id where cm.conversation_id = #{conversationId} order by u.id
select count(*) from conversation_members where conversation_id = #{conversationId}

mapper.delete: delete from conversation_members where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into chat_messages(conversation_id, sender_id, message_type, content, file_url, file_name, file_size, file_type, send_time, client_msg_id, recalled) values (#{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{messageType}, #{content}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{sendTime}, #{clientMsgId}, 0)
mapper.select: select c.id, c.conversation_id, c.sender_id, u.nickname, u.avatar, c.message_type, c.content, c.file_url, c.file_name, c.file_size, c.file_type, c.send_time from chat_messages c join users u on u.id = c.sender_id where c.conversation_id = #{conversationId} and (#{beforeId} is null or c.id < #{beforeId}) order by c.id desc limit #{limit}
select max(id) from chat_messages where conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.update: update chat_messages set recalled = 1 where id = #{messageId} and sender_id = #{userId} and recalled = 0 and send_time > date_sub(now(), interval 2 minute)
